name: Gift of Growth — kicked replaces the 'It gets +2/+2' sentence
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py ('otherwise' / 'if kicked … instead' theme). 'Untap target creature. It gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn instead.' The replaced sentence starts with a pronoun; when it moves to its own line the pronoun must be resolved to the spell's target or it becomes a self-effect on the spell. Kicked: Bears are 6/6, not 4/4 or 8/8.
